headline: Night mode wakes up cleanly, and the dot on the menu-bar icon now tells you what to fix.

items.title: Waking from night mode
items.detail: After the night key, the screens stay on until you have unlocked your Mac. They no longer go dark again, and lock the session, a few seconds after you unlock.

items.title: The menu-bar dot, explained
items.detail: Hover the icon to see why it shows a dot. The menu now lists what needs you first: a missing permission or an update waiting.

items.title: Permissions repaired in one click
items.detail: When Accessibility or Full Disk Access stops working while Everest is still ticked in System Settings, a Repair button resets the entry and asks again, with the steps shown alongside.

items.title: Claude and Codex keys
items.detail: When Everest cannot read CodexBar's data, the menu-bar icon, the menu and the DisplayPad page now say so and lead to the fix.

items.title: Dated logs
items.detail: Every line of the listener's log now starts with its date.
